Alice / Marissa,

Below are concise technical responses to the key items from your questionnaire. Happy to expand any row if you need example requests/responses.

--- SSO / Authentication ---
- SAML: We support SAML 2.0 SP-initiated and IdP-initiated flows. SP metadata (saml-metadata.xml) includes assertionConsumerService, SingleLogoutService, and signing cert. Typical attributes we accept: email (required), given_name, family_name, groups. NameID supports email and transient formats.
- OIDC: We support Authorization Code + PKCE, service accounts (client_credentials) for machine-to-machine. OIDC discovery URL: https://auth.redwood.com/.well-known/openid-configuration
- Signed assertions: We accept signed assertions; encryption optional. We support signature verification by x509 cert.

--- Provisioning / SCIM ---
- SCIM version: 2.0 (RFC7644)
- Endpoints:
  * GET /scim/v2/Users
  * POST /scim/v2/Users
  * PATCH /scim/v2/Users/{id} (supports JSON Patch), for delta provisioning
  * GET /scim/v2/Groups
- Change model: We support incremental provisioning via PATCH and list changes by filtering updatedAt; we also support full-sync (bulk export) over a time-window if requested.
- Deprovisioning: On user delete we emit status=inactive and optional hard-delete per customer policy. Immediate deprovisioning SLA for SCIM calls is best-effort; typical propagation within 2 min for single-user operations, bulk jobs depend on batch size.
- Authentication to SCIM API: Bearer token scoped to provisioning service account; tokens can be rotated and we support customer-managed secrets for long-lived tokens.

--- RBAC & Admin controls ---
- Model: multi-tenant namespaces + role assignment. Roles: account_admin, org_admin, project_admin, developer, auditor, read_only. Role permissions are additive and scoped.
- Delegation: account_admin can create org_admins and assign limited roles. Project_admin can manage resources within a project without account-wide access.
- MFA: Admin roles require MFA enforcement; supported methods: TOTP, WebAuthn/FIDO2, and SSO-enforced MFA from IdP.
- Session & secrets: session timeout defaults to 24 hours for non-admin, 8 hours for admin UI sessions; adjustable via enterprise policy.

--- Audit & retention ---
- Audit events: user.create, user.update, user.delete, role.assign, role.revoke, scim.provision, scim.deprovision, sso.login, sso.logout, admin.action.*
- Retention: Admin UI audit events retained for 90 days by default; exportable as NDJSON/CSV. Longer retention (custom retention windows) available as an add-on.
- Exports: We provide time-bounded export endpoints and can stream to customer S3 under contract for long-term archiving.

--- Key Management & Encryption ---
- Data at rest: AES-256.
- KMS: Customer-managed key support via AWS KMS and GCP KMS for private deployments; hosted customers can opt for Redwood-managed KMS.

--- Evidence included in attachments ---
- scim-endpoints.json (example GET/POST payloads)
- rbac-matrix.csv (roles -> permissions mapping)
- saml-metadata.xml (SP metadata)

If FinTrak needs signed statements around provisioning SLA or an extractable audit sample, we can prepare a short attestation. Planning to deliver the initial packet by EOD 2025-07-04 as Marissa outlined.

Thanks,
